{{Short description|Lithuanian politician (1931–2022)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2022}}

[[File:Leaders of the Supreme Council of Lithuania on 11 March 1990.jpg|thumb|Aloyzas Sakalas (first from the right) on 11 March 1990, after the promulgation of the [[Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania]]]]

'''Aloyzas Sakalas''' (6 July 1931 – 18 July 2022)<ref>{{cite web|title=Mirė Nepriklausomybės akto signataras Aloyzas Sakalas|url=https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/lietuvoje/2/1740989/mire-nepriklausomybes-akto-signataras-aloyzas-sakalas|website=lrt.lt|accessdate=18 July 2022|language=Lithuanian|date=18 July 2022}}</ref> was a Lithuanian politician, signatory of the [[Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania]], and [[Member of the European Parliament]] with the [[Social Democratic Party of Lithuania]]. Aloyzas Sakalas was also a part of the [[Party of European Socialists|Socialist Group]] and sat on the [[European Parliament]]'s [[Committee on Legal Affairs]].<ref>{{cite web |title=6th parliamentary term {{!}} Aloyzas SAKALAS {{!}} MEPs {{!}} European Parliament |url=https://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/28281/ALOYZAS_SAKALAS/history/6 |website=www.europarl.europa.eu |access-date=31 December 2024 |language=en |date=6 July 1931}}</ref>

Aloyzas Sakalas was a substitute for the [[Committee on Foreign Affairs (EU)|Committee on Foreign Affairs]] and a member of the Delegation for relations with Belarus. He had three children.<ref>{{cite news |title=Po trumpo gedulo A. Sakalas veda trečią kartą / Žmonės / lrytas.lt |url=http://www.lrytas.lt//pramogos/zmones/po-trumpo-gedulo-a-sakalas-veda-trecia-karta.htm |access-date=31 December 2024 |work=Lrytas |date=24 January 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150124015138/http://www.lrytas.lt//pramogos/zmones/po-trumpo-gedulo-a-sakalas-veda-trecia-karta.htm |archive-date=2015-01-24}}</ref>

==Education==
* 1960: [[academic degree|Degree]] in [[radio engineer]]ing from the [[Kaunas Polytechnic Institute]]<ref>{{cite book |title=Eurosource |date=2006 |publisher=DOD |isbn=978-0-905702-68-1 |page=348 |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Eurosource/nmxmAAAAMAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&bsq=aloyzas+sakalas+%E2%80%9E1977%22&dq=aloyzas+sakalas+%E2%80%9E1977%22&printsec=frontcover |access-date=31 December 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
* 1969: Doctorate from [[Vilnius State University]]<ref>{{cite web |title=LIETUVOS MOKSLO POTENCIALAS |url=http://www.mokslas.mii.lt/mokslas/SRITYS/duom00.php?pav=S&sritis=F |website=www.mokslas.mii.lt |access-date=31 December 2024}}</ref>
* 1972: Associate Professor
* 1977: Qualification as a professor of Physics and Mathematics
* 1980: Professor at the [[University of Vilnius]]

==Career==
* 1960–1962: Engineer at the Institute for Electrographics<ref>{{cite web |title=Aloyzas SAKALAS - biografija |url=https://www.vrk.lt/statiniai/puslapiai/rinkimai/2004/euro/kandidatai/kand_biog_l_260852.htm |website=www.vrk.lt |access-date=31 December 2024}}</ref>
* 1982–1990: Lecturer of the Associate Professor and Professor at the [[University of Vilnius]]
* 1989–1991: Member of the Lithuanian Social Democratic Party (LDSP)
* 1991–1999: Chairman of the LSDP
* since 1999: Honorary Chairman of the LSDP<ref>{{cite web |title=Aloyzas Sakalas |url=https://www.vle.lt/straipsnis/aloyzas-sakalas/ |website=www.vle.lt |access-date=31 December 2024 |language=lt}}</ref>
* 1990–1992: Chairman of the Committee on the Verification of Credentials of the Parliament of the Republic of Lithuania
* 1992–1996: Deputy President of Parliament<ref>{{cite web |title=Mirė socialdemokratas, Nepriklausomybės Akto signataras Aloyzas Sakalas |url=https://www.lsdp.lt/straipsniai/partijos-naujienos/mire-socialdemokratas-nepriklausomybes-akto-signataras-aloyzas-sakalas/ |website=LSDP |access-date=31 December 2024 |language=lt-LT |date=18 July 2022}}</ref>
* 1996–2004: Member of Parliament
* 2000–2004: Chairman of the Parliament's Committee on Legal Affairs
* 1996–2004: Chairman of the organisation 'Help Lithuanian Children'<ref>{{cite news |title=124 Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo akto signatarai: kaip vėliau susiklostė jų likimai? |url=https://ve.lt/gyvenimas/124-nepriklausomybes-atkurimo-akto-signatarai-kaip-veliau-susikloste-ju-likimai |access-date=31 December 2024 |work=VE |date=11 March 2022 |language=lt}}</ref>
